svg.aria-label: The six steps of the CI job, what each checks, and the failure or review behind it. One of them cannot fail today.
svg.text: The six steps that run on every push
One CI job on every push. Each step runs even when an earlier one has failed, so each reports its own result.

g.text: Test suite
476 tests. An autouse fixture takes a
fingerprint of two protected state folders
under .git after every test.
Tests wrote into the repo three times, once in .git.
Mutation harness
49 rows. Each disables one check and
requires a named test to fail with the
marker declared for it.
Twice, a green test was hiding a dead guard.
Documentation guard
A preregistration is dated by the commit
of its current text; every rule declared
implemented must name a symbol that exists.
Added after a PREREG was written after the result.
Completeness census
numpy load and save may appear only in
the artefact module. Checked on the AST,
with exemptions declared per call site.
Four times, a fix covered one path of several.
Probe registry
CANNOT FAIL TODAY
Each declared probe rule must resolve to
a function that imports and can be called.
The registry is empty, so the step passes.
Added in review, to check names resolve to code.
Register count
The tally of the 93-entry register is rebuilt
from its tables. The step fails if it is stale
or if two entries share an id.
In CI since a stale tally was published for 44 rows.

svg.text: None of these steps looks at an estimate. The +18.24 was withdrawn after a checklist review on 24 August, an incident
report on 26 August and a post hoc re-analysis on 7 September 2026, none of which runs in CI.
